Original Tallow & Honey Balm
Beverlee Simmons (Simpsonville, US)
The best ever!!!

I meant to write a review on day one. I had been using other beef tallow brands for quite a while and had seen some improvements. As I did a deep dive into brands I realized there really was a difference. So I got AI recommendations on the best brands and it included Ancestral. The first time I put it on my face I felt a huge difference. The prior brand also had honey in it but when I rubbed it in the tallow would "pill". Add makeup on top of that and it came off in little rolls as I tried to smooth it in. With Ancestral it was smooth and moisturizing. Over time I see my skin has become smoother and less wrinkled. I am a customer for life!!!
